column1: # Benchmark queries: group<TAB>query, in code-search's query language.
# Picked for the repos in benchmarks/repos.tsv. The file counts in the
# comments are from `rg -i -F -l` over all three repos.
# rare: in a few dozen files at most
# short: 1 or 2 bytes, so the index can't narrow anything down
# filter: path:, lang: and repo: carry most of the query
# long: many trigrams, so the index step does the most work
